comment: Which font draws each of the maps' font tags (port/linux/src/text_hires.c). units_per_pixel marks a font rebuilt from the tag's own letters (tools/og_font.py): that many font units are one pixel of the tag, and its glyphs are drawn from the pen with no fitting. Without it the font is a substitute typeface, sized by the tag's capital height and fitted to each original glyph's ink.
